• New (iOS): Auto Sync listens to a short excerpt of actual movie audio using on-device Apple Speech, matches spoken English to subtitle lines, and adjusts their timing when multiple phrases agree.
• Safety: No offset is applied when speech or matching is unreliable.
• Note: Requires Speech permission and external English subtitles. iOS-readable MP4/HLS/local audio only; some MKV or protected streams cannot be analyzed.
